name: Oracle MCP Servers
description: Connects MCP clients to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Oracle Database, MySQL HeatWave and GoldenGate through Oracle's open-source reference MCP servers.

skills.name: OCI SDK Calls
skills.description: Finds, describes, and invokes any OCI Python SDK client operation by class and method name through one general server.

skills.name: OCI CLI Commands
skills.description: Discovers and runs OCI CLI commands through the CLI-backed OCI API MCP server, using your configured OCI profile.

skills.name: MySQL HeatWave
skills.description: Executes SQL and uses MySQL AI or HeatWave ML and GenAI tools, including RAG over vector stores, on MySQL connections.

skills.name: Database Tools
skills.description: Lists autonomous databases and connections across a tenancy and runs SQL through OCI Database Tools connections.

skills.name: GoldenGate Administration
skills.description: Manages GoldenGate deployments through the GoldenGate Administration REST APIs, covering process lifecycle and monitoring.
